# Air Quality Advisor v0.3.0 — Deterministic indoor-environment science

This release adds optional research-grounded building-physics and historical
exposure diagnostics to the existing one-sensor Home Assistant Air Quality
Advisor integration, without introducing any cloud data services.

## New measurements

- **Real moisture comparison:** humidity ratio (g/kg of dry air), vapor density,
  dew point, drying potential, and warmed-outside-air relative humidity.
- **Adaptive comfort:** indicative ASHRAE 55 temperature bands (only with
  seven days of sufficiently complete outdoor measurements and required
  natural-conditioning applicability assumptions).
- **Passive cooling:** ambient cooling opportunity when outdoor conditions
  already pass the configured weather and pollution safety policy.
- **Cold surfaces:** surface condensation margin and historical hours above
  estimated 80% surface RH when mold calibration is available.
- **24-hour particulate averages:** time-weighted PM2.5 and PM10 concentrations,
  only with at least 80% coverage; compares as context with WHO 2021
  *24-hour* references, never treats a single instantaneous reading as WHO compliance.
- **Ventilation effectiveness:** CO₂ trends and guarded air-change estimates,
  withheld unless actual outdoor CO₂, a continuous open-window period and
  unoccupied sensor evidence exist.
- **Heat/overheating:** approximate sensible energy per cubic meter for
  one full air exchange and *observed* nighttime hours above 26°C (not CIBSE
  TM59 design-stage certification).

## Reliability and privacy

- Invalid CO₂ and relative-humidity measurements become unknown.
- A CO₂ entity is not proof of NDIR hardware; confirm sensor technology.
- Real paired moisture data can suppress counterproductive humidity-only
  opening advice; rain, wind, cold/outside-temperature policy, dangerous
  pollution and active weather warnings still take precedence.
- Derived values are shown in the existing Lovelace card and sensor attributes.
- A local Home Assistant Store cache retains up to eight days of time-series
  measurements, including occupancy booleans and window contacts when
  available, with bounded sampling and expiry. Nothing is sent to a new cloud.
- Unknown sensor inputs remain unavailable; PMV/PPD and VTT mold index are
  deliberately not approximated without the required physical inputs.

## Compatibility and updating

The current entity IDs, monitored rooms, existing config entries, mold calibration
values and Air Quality Advisor → Announcement Hub `area` routing are preserved.
Update via HACS and restart Home Assistant to load new Python logic. Temporal
indicators will need to gather sufficient samples after installation.

The GitHub release pipeline only publishes the version after unit, frontend,
translation, Hassfest and HACS validations have passed.
